title: Universal Application-Object Direct Manipulation (unified pick + left-click + drag/drop + right-click + delete)
scope: final direct-manipulation architecture build before repository/engineering-document reconciliation audit; no Build 2, no transport routing/animation

one_interaction_contract.resolver: resolveAppObjectPickTarget(ray, candidates, selected?) — selected-preference then nearest; hidden excluded; planning volumes / native BIM never candidates; whole-volume candidate so any subcomponent resolves the one instance

unified_overlay_layer.buildAppObjectCandidates: equipment OBB + vestibule full occupied AABB; excludes planning volumes / BIM
unified_overlay_layer.getSelectedAppObjectRef_selectAppObject: one selection over per-family authorities (selecting one clears the other)
unified_overlay_layer.deleteAppObject: ONE dispatcher -> deleteEquipment / deleteVestibule; no duplicate logic; no window.confirm
unified_overlay_layer.moveEquipmentToFloorPoint: -> updateEquipmentPlacement (collision-checked + persisted; Z pinned to room floor)
unified_overlay_layer.slideVestibuleToWallPoint: wall-tangent slide (front flush, rear behind wall), room-side collision-checked, persisted, rebuilds only its own ports

vestibule_domain.slideVestibuleAlongWall: tangent-only, clamped to usable wall span; front flush; rear behind wall
vestibule_domain.evaluateWallSnap: different defensible wall via explicit threshold + hysteresis; same vestibuleInstanceId

tool_routing.right_click_event_delivery: capture-phase contextmenu bridge on active viewport, idempotent re-install on left-click, independent of Clinical Program panel / cards / prior left-click
tool_routing.delete_key: Delete/Backspace deletes selected app object; gesture-safe + focus-safe (not in input/textarea/select/contenteditable); locked refused

universal_drag.equipment: floor-plane (ray -> Z=room floor -> X/Y); collision-checked authoritative move per motion; last-valid on rejection; Escape restores pre-drag pose; Z never floats
universal_drag.vestibule: wall-tangent slide only (front flush, rear behind wall); clamped to wall span; deliberate wall-snap (threshold/hysteresis); same instanceId

preserved_no_regression: floating SELECTED EQUIPMENT / SELECTED VESTIBULE controls
per-family context menus (opened via the one resolver)
honesty_note: Live browser pointer-drag, right-click event delivery, and camera-relative picking are not headlessly verifiable; the unified picker, delete dispatcher, focus-safety, equipment floor-move + collision, vestibule wall-slide/snap, and the independent-pose invariant are test/typecheck/build verified. Live interaction is the authoritative manual acceptance step.
